# Bundled barcode reader

ZXing JS library 0.21.3, UMD distribution, Apache-2.0.

- Source: https://github.com/zxing-js/library/tree/v0.21.3
- Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@zxing/library@0.21.3/umd/index.min.js
- License: `ZXING-LICENSE` (included in the installation archive).

Loaded from the site's own allowlisted `barcode-reader.js` asset only when the
browser has no usable native BarcodeDetector. No CDN request occurs at runtime;
camera frames stay on the device. Update the pinned version and license together.
